inverse.note: Independent axes, not nine proven original hardware designs. A component labelled 'cap' across coil L shares its U,V nodes but does not identify that coil with NST A-B or A-M.

isolatedCut.premises: Completely floating U/V source island, four ideal forward-only U/V-to-P diode edges, no other conductor/displacement/radiative/switch return, each diode current nonnegative
isolatedCut.result: Each package current zero; sustained useful work through the positive-only diode cut must vanish in this ideal model
isolatedCut.counterconditions: Any physical external return including capacitance/leakage/another switch invalidates that no-return cut; not evidence of actual wired Filsinger absence of return

capacitiveReturnModel.circuit: ideal AC differential source U-V=e; Cu from U to M, Cv from V to M, positive real load conductance G from U to M; s=i*w
capacitiveReturnModel.fundedWork: Re(e*conj(Is))=G*abs(U)^2; ideal capacitors absorb zero mean real power
capacitiveReturnModel.falseTap: When Cu=Cv and G=0: U=+e/2, V=-e/2 even without a galvanic physical midpoint
capacitiveReturnModel.load: A positive G moves common-mode voltage; pure ideal hard tap would remain +/-e/2 if ideal zero source impedance; a real hard tap can also sag, so this is NOT unique original-source inference
capacitiveReturnModel.normalized: Cu=Cv=G=w=e=1 gives exactly 1/5 normalized input real power and load real power
capacitiveReturnModel.important: Proxy is linear resistive load, NOT Filsinger's nonlinear diode and spark gap model
